data.name: Help
data.value: SQL Server → PostgreSQL or PostgreSQL → PostgreSQL data migration Usage: dotnet run --project WebApplication1.Infrastructure/DataMigration/WebApplication1.DataMigration.csproj -- [--postgres-to-postgres] --dry-run|--execute --dry-run copies, validates and rolls back the transaction. --execute commits the copy. Use --postgres-to-postgres to select PostgreSQL as the source. Configure ConnectionStrings:SqlServer, ConnectionStrings:Postgres and Migration:SourceTimeZone in the utility appsettings.json. MIGRATION_* environment variables override the file. For PostgreSQL → PostgreSQL configure MIGRATION_POSTGRES_SOURCE_CONNECTION; optional schemas are MIGRATION_POSTGRES_SOURCE_SCHEMA and MIGRATION_POSTGRES_SCHEMA (both public). Optional: MIGRATION_SQLSERVER_SCHEMA (dbo), MIGRATION_POSTGRES_SCHEMA (public), MIGRATION_COMMAND_TIMEOUT_SECONDS (120), MIGRATION_COLUMN_TIME_ZONES (JSON), MIGRATION_LANGUAGE (pt-BR/en). The destination must have the seven tables created and empty. See DataMigration/README.md.
